analysis.headline: Shares Your Data for Ads
analysis.quote: Although we do not sell your personal information for money, we do “share” your information where defined under applicable law to include the processing and disclosing your personal information to third parties for purposes of serving you advertisements based on your activity across other sites and services (“cross-context behavioral advertising” or “targeted advertising”).

analysis.headline: Shares with Corporate Group
analysis.quote: We may share Information We Collect with affiliates controlled by, or under common control with, us as necessary for the purposes set forth within this Privacy Policy.

analysis.headline: Trains AI on Your Content
analysis.quote: We will use your information in order to: ...train, test, and improve technology, such as machine learning models and algorithms, including by analyzing how people are using the Services; ... and scanning, analyzing, and reviewing User Content;

analysis.headline: Accesses Your Clipboard Content
analysis.quote: Additionally, we access clipboard content, such as text and images, through your device's clipboard when you choose to use certain functions, such as initiating information sharing with third-party services, or copying and pasting clipboard content onto our Services.

analysis.headline: Collects Pre-upload Content
analysis.quote: We may collect User Content through pre-uploading at the time of creation, import, or upload, regardless of whether you choose to save or publish that User Content, for example, to recommend audio options, generate captions, and provide other personalized recommendations.

analysis.headline: Collects Off-Service Activity
analysis.quote: Advertisers, analytics, and other partners share information with us about you and the actions you have taken outside of the Services, such as your activities on other websites and apps.

analysis.headline: Shares Your Data with Government
analysis.quote: We may share the “Information We Collect” with certain competent law enforcement, regulatory or government agencies, courts, or other third parties if we have a good faith belief that it is necessary to: Comply with a legal obligation; Lawfully protect and defend the rights, property, safety, and security of the Services, our users, copyright holders, and others;

analysis.headline: Ignores 'Do Not Track'
analysis.quote: Please note that the Services do not currently support “Do Not Track” requests.

analysis.headline: Pippit for Adults Only
analysis.quote: Pippit is intended for and should only be used by, adults (persons who meet the legal consent age in each applicable jurisdiction) and not children or minors. We do not seek or knowingly collect any personal data about children under the age of 18.
